Jobs & Volunteers

Ajax Public Library is an equal opportunity employer, committed to diversity within the workplace. As we grow, it is important that our workforce becomes more reflective of the citizens we serve. The Ajax Public Library respects, encourages, and celebrates our diversity.

Accommodations are available for all recruitment processes. Applicants are encouraged to make their needs known in advance by contacting the Coordinator of Human Resources via email.

Current Job Opportunities

Page (Permanent, Part-Time - Three (3) Vacancies)
Deadline to apply: Friday, October 23, 2026, at 5 p.m.

Current Library Volunteer Opportunities

Older Adults Advisory Committee Volunteers 
If you are 55+ and a resident of Ajax, the Library needs you! We are looking for members to form our 2027–2028 Older Adults Advisory Committee. By becoming a member, you will have a chance to share your ideas on how the Library can prepare for a growing older adult population and provide services that are accessible to and inclusive of older residents with diverse needs.

Interested in being part of the discussion? For more information and to receive an application form, email Elaine at [email protected].

Application deadline: Friday, November 6, 2026
